pins.name: XSHUT
pins.notes: Shutdown, active LOW. Optional; needed to use several sensors

gotchas.text: Every sensor starts at address 0x29. To use two on one bus, hold one in reset with XSHUT and give the other a new address at start-up; the new address is lost at power-off.

source.title: ST VL53L0X datasheet
source.section: I²C interface: device address 0x52 (8-bit), change of address

current.note: Average while ranging; 5 µA in hardware standby.

source.title: ST VL53L0X datasheet
